name: Wanjiru Kamau
title: Soul Vocalist & Guitarist
bio: Performs original Kikuyu-Swahili soul and has played weddings, church galas and hotel lounges across Kenya.
needs: Clear, uncluttered path to the stage; verbal cues on stage layout; a stool and music stand placed in advance.

name: Otieno Odhiambo
title: Mixed-media Painter
bio: Paints Lake Victoria fishing life in bold acrylic and recycled materials. Live-painting sessions available.
needs: Step-free access to the display area; work table at 75cm height; wide aisles.

name: Amina Hassan
title: Motivational Speaker & MC
bio: Speaks on inclusive business and youth enterprise. Presents in Kenyan Sign Language with voice interpretation.
needs: Sign language interpreter on stage; live captions screen; good lighting on the speaker.

name: Baraka Mwangi
title: Beadwork & Sisal Artisan
bio: Runs live craft demonstrations and workshops for guests, making beaded jewellery and woven baskets.
needs: Step-free entry; wide stable table; supportive seating; extra setup time.

name: Njeri Wambui
title: Pastry Chef
bio: Creates East African-inspired pastries and plated desserts for hotel events and tasting evenings.
needs: Shaded, well-lit kitchen workspace; sun protection for outdoor setups.

name: Kiprono Cheruiyot
title: Drummer & Percussionist
bio: Plays a custom-adapted kit blending traditional Kalenjin rhythms with modern afrobeat.
needs: Ramp to the stage; space for a custom drum rack; sound check 1 hour early.
